title: pi-marimo
body: A live marimo notebook beside Pi's chat. Keys pressed appear below the window.

title: /marimo edit demo.py
body: Starts a marimo server and docks the notebook beside the chat. No browser.

title: A A  ·  run all
body: Every cell runs. The outline shows each cell's state; outputs render in the terminal.

title: /  ·  find a cell
body: Jump to a cell by name. Plotly charts draw as real images.

title: w  ·  drive widgets
body: Move the slider from the keyboard; the chart reruns.

title: t  ·  tables
body: Page, sort and select rows. Space selects days, and the chart marks them.

title: a  ·  ask the agent
body: Ask about the selected cell. The agent edits the notebook through marimo pair while you watch.

title: c  ·  the agent's change
body: Jump to the cell the agent created; it is marked new.

title: d  ·  the diff
body: See exactly what the agent wrote. u would revert it.
